title: Bulk move previews what it sets off: invites, assignments, erased offers

gates._gates_note: tsc, unit and perf non-zero on FOREIGN paths only - see notes

deviations_from_card: (1) pipelineBulkSelection.ts joined the write set, per the coordinator's hand-off (slot A moved the confirm slot and actionableRows there): BulkWhich now derives from BulkConfirm ('move' added), actionableRows('move') = active rows, cohortSignature/armedBulkConfirm take an optional moveTarget so a move confirm signs WHERE as well as WHO, new state field movePreview and event 'previewed'. (2) The hook reads arrivalBranch (the finer branch: not_interview_role vs no_ai_round), and arrivalEffect is the derived coarse effect; effectiveInterviewGate now delegates to the pure resolveInterviewGate, and stage-hooks exports interviewPlanSaved for the route. (3) Like slot A, the preview rides the status line (BulkResult verb 'previewed' + preview summary, plus heldBack) instead of new bar props, so usePipelineTabState.ts / PipelinePopulatedBoard.tsx stayed out of the write set; the hook hides a 'previewed' line whenever the move confirm is not armed. The confirm's Cancel reuses pipeline.tab.bulkRejectCancel. (4) needsConfirm also counts held AI invites (the candidate is parked for a human) besides outbound, erased and held-back effects. (5) Dry-run preview rows the server refused (CAS miss, closed, terminal) are carried into the commit settle as per-id failures with their code, so they stay selected. (6) Commit order: catalogs (lock) first, then test, feat, doc (lock).
